--- create_table_foreign_key_on_delete_set_null.sql
CREATE TABLE Child (
  Id INT64 NOT NULL,
  ParentId INT64,
  FOREIGN KEY (ParentId) REFERENCES Parent (Id) ON DELETE SET NULL
) PRIMARY KEY (Id)
